classification.difficultyReason: The same task type as p14-q4: identify a parallelogram, trapezium, kite and rhombus from their marks.

content.prompt: Identify the special quadrilateral as a parallelogram, rhombus, trapezium, or kite.

answer.worked: Parallelogram: both pairs of opposite sides are marked parallel.
Trapezium: it has one pair of parallel sides.
Kite: the ticks show two pairs of adjacent equal sides.
Rhombus: all four sides have the same equality tick.
